violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Observed food employee change gloves, but did not wash her hands before putting on new pair. Hands should be washed before putting on gloves.

Preventing contamination by employees. — --Employee's single-use gloves were not discarded after being damaged or soiled. Observed food employee wipe gloved hands on towel and continue using the same gloves. Dirtied gloves should be changed.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Solution for wiping cloth bucket found at 0ppm- quat. Quat solutions for holding wiping cloths should be between 150-400ppm, depending on manufacturer directions. ***Corrected during inspection.
